name: Craig Sanderson
title: Contact Psychologist
description: Craig Sanderson holds a Master’s degree in Psychology and is a fully registered Psychologist with the Australian Health Practioner Regulation Agency and is a member of the Australian Psychological Society. Craig has been a practicing psychologist for over 17 years. This is a deeper form of therapy undertaken with the client, exploring past experiences and traumas that continue to impact the client, and their life choices. Areas of experience include, but are not limited to: anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, self-esteem, spirituality, and anger management.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Christopher Carter
title: Psychologist
description: I am a psychologist with experience working with adults and adolescents in clinical mental health, trauma, and addiction. I listen without judgment and provide psychotherapy (talk therapy) that is tailored to each individual, the work is confidential.
specialties: Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Belinda Jude
title: Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist with over 25 years experience, having trained initially in the forensic, drug and alcohol and public adult mental health sectors (catt team and inpatient units). I'm currently in private practice in the inner north working with an amazing diverse population which includes neurodiversity, queer, trans, sex workers, young people, uni students, people identifying as poly in their relationships, and also working with adults who may have trauma or relationship issues, and are generally experiencing difficulty navigating life in the current climate.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sex worker issues, Schema Therapy

name: Shiao-Hua Kwong
title: Psychologist
description: Fluent in English, Mandarin and Cantonese, I am a clinical psychologist who works with adults and older adolescents (17+). I believe meaningful change begins with understanding. I have particular interests in working with bipolar disorder, mood disorders, anxiety disorders and relational trauma.
specialties: Sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Niki Yuen Fen Bruysters
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Hi! My name's Niki and I'm a clinical psychologist, and within my practice I aim to create a warm and welcoming environment where my clients feel accepted and heard. I have worked with adults from all walks of life within private and public mental health settings, and have a keen interest in working with people experiencing challenges with: – Anxiety – Mood – Trauma – Eating and Body Image – Vulnerable Personality – Connection-seeking behaviours of concern – Stress and Burn Out I am passionate about shifting the 'hush-hush' discourse around vulnerabilities with mental health, and empowering individuals to embrace the human nature to experience difficulties.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Simon Kimm
title: Psychologist
description: Simon is a proud Burramattagal man and clinical psychologist who supports clients aged 15 and over. A former ADF member with lived military experience, Simon brings deep insight to his work with veterans and others navigating trauma, identity, and change. He uses CBT, EMDR, and psychotherapy, and is experienced in assessing and diagnosing mental health conditions including ADHD and autism. Simon has worked in private practice and hospital settings, supporting people through trauma, substance use, grief, relationship difficulties, and gender or identity concerns. Areas of Interest: Veteran Mental Health – Trauma – Grief & Loss – Substance Use – Indigenous Mental Health – Neurodiversity
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Tim Jezard
title: Psychologist
address: 43 Challis St, Newport Counselling & Psychology Service
description: Tim is a registered psychologist with over 25 years experience in education and the A&D field. He was the Head of Student Services at a large independent school in Melbourne but now focuses his attention on his private practice providing counselling and psychotherapy to individuals in the inner west of Melbourne.

name: Hana Perkins-Simonova
title: Psychologist
description: Hana is a registered psychologist, researcher, musician, and mother of two. She has a rich experience working with adults, children and families in Australia, the Czech Republic and Peru. She uses a range of evidence-based and trauma informed approaches and techniques including Internal Family Systems (IFS) Therapy (Level 2 trained), Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Mindfulness-based Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Analytical Psychotherapy, and Expressive Therapy, as well as relaxation techniques.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse
